brief_gesture_description: The person stands facing the camera, then turns their torso slightly to the side and extends both arms forward, moving them in a horizontal back-and-forth sawing motion at waist height before returning to a neutral standing position.

iconicity.rationale: The horizontal back-and-forth motion of the hands clearly mimics the action of using a hand saw, strongly resembling the meaning of the word.

sensorimotor_imagery.rationale: The rhythmic, repetitive pushing and pulling motion feels like a genuine physical effort, evoking the tactile sensation of sawing through material.

motional_salience_gesture.rationale: The movement is moderate in size, confined to the arms and torso without large body displacement, but the dynamic back-and-forth motion is clearly visible.

emotional_salience_facial_expression.rationale: The facial expression remains neutral and focused throughout the gesture, showing no distinct emotional display.

gesture_complexity_fit.rationale: The simple, repetitive mechanical motion perfectly matches the straightforward physical concept of sawing.

cultural_familiarity.rationale: The gesture is a universally recognized pantomime for sawing, commonly understood across various cultural contexts.

enactment_potential.rationale: The gesture is very easy to perform, requiring only a simple rhythmic movement of the arms and hands without complex coordination.

possible_ambiguities: Without an object, the gesture could be interpreted as other repetitive horizontal motions, but the context strongly supports sawing.
